name: Print.com Print on Demand
author: printdotcom

sections.description:
Start or grow your print-on-demand business with Print.com. This plug-in will make it easy for you to connect your WooCommerce store.

Key Features:
1. Easily set-up your Print.com account.
2. Connect your Products with a Print.com Product.

What price does my preset have?

Unfortunately we cannot store prices as they change every week. This might be a feature that will be implemented.

Where can I find more information?

We have a more information in our knowledge base at https://knowledge.print.com/nl/helpcenter/solutions#print-on-demand-plugin-woocommerce.

About Print.com

Print.com is pure print passion, only for pros. A specialised crew, access to the latest technology, and a selection of over 1000 premium printed products. So tell us: what does your ideal print journey look like? Book a free test flight and discover what first-class service is all about.

Roadmap

Soon to come:

  • Configure automatic purchasing
sections.installation:
To allow this plug-in to work, you only need an account with Print.com.
Start by entering your account and password in the admin section of this plug-in.

Don’t have an account yet?
You can request an account by contacting Print.com at +31 (0)88 751 11 11 or mailing to info@print.com.
